description: Source code for the FreeType library's TrueType object management, including glyph zone handling, font face initialization and finalization, size object management, and driver setup.

methods.name: tt_glyphzone_done
methods.description: Deallocates a glyph zone, freeing its allocated arrays and resetting counters.

methods.name: tt_glyphzone_new
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new glyph zone with specified capacity.

methods.name: tt_check_trickyness_family
methods.description: Checks if a font family name matches known tricky fonts.

methods.name: tt_synth_sfnt_checksum
methods.description: Calculates the checksum of an SFNT table from a font stream.

methods.name: tt_get_sfnt_checksum
methods.description: Retrieves the checksum of a font table, computing it if necessary.

methods.name: tt_check_trickyness_sfnt_ids
methods.description: Checks if a font's SFNT table checksums match known tricky font signatures.

methods.name: tt_check_trickyness
methods.description: Determines if a font is tricky based on name or SFNT table signatures.

methods.name: tt_check_single_notdef
methods.description: Checks if the font has only a single glyph, the .notdef glyph.

methods.name: tt_face_init
methods.description: Initializes a TrueType font face object from a font stream.

methods.name: tt_face_done
methods.description: Finalizes and frees resources associated with a TrueType font face.

methods.name: tt_size_run_fpgm
methods.description: Executes the font program (fpgm) table in a size object.

methods.name: tt_size_run_prep
methods.description: Executes the control value program (prep) in a size object.

methods.name: tt_size_init
methods.description: Initializes a size object for a TrueType font.

methods.name: tt_size_done
methods.description: Finalizes a size object, freeing associated resources.

methods.name: tt_size_reset
methods.description: Resets a size object when resolution or character size changes.
